authority.decision: The owner confirmed customer 24969 is the shared walk-in General identity.
preserve: all linked sales, returns, and historical customer snapshots
all address and other stored profile evidence
exclude: customer 22305, which is a real customer with phone 086897171

prerequisites: Deploy migration 0141 and the F72 marker-aware application code before this repair.
Immediately before the write, fetch id, name, phone, membership_number, is_anonymous, updated_at and the portal-account count for id 24969 through the root-owned read-only production path.
Substitute the exact fresh updated_at value as @expectedUpdatedAt. Do not guess or reuse an older timestamp.
Require is_anonymous=0 and portal-account count=0 in the same preflight. Stop on any mismatch.

atomic_batch.sql: UPDATE customers SET is_anonymous = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = @id AND name IS @name AND phone IS @phone AND membership_number IS @membershipNumber AND is_anonymous = 0 AND updated_at IS @expectedUpdatedAt AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM portal_accounts WHERE contact_id = customers.id)
SELECT CASE WHEN changes() = 1 THEN 1 ELSE json_extract('f72_anonymous_repair_guard_failed', '$') END AS repair_guard

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customers WHERE id = 24969 AND name IS 'general' AND phone IS '' AND membership_number IS 'LC-04971' AND is_anonymous = 1) THEN 1 ELSE json_extract('f72_anonymous_repair_postcondition_failed', '$') END AS post_guard

post_assertions: Exactly one customer row changed and id 24969 now has is_anonymous=1.
Sales count for customer_id=24969 remains 5 and returns count remains 1 at the observed baseline, unless the fresh preflight documents legitimate intervening activity.
membership_number remains byte-for-byte LC-04971; the application masks and disables its use without deleting historical evidence.
No portal account points to customer 24969.

recovery.automatic: Any guard failure rolls the one-row update back because all three statements must run in one D1 batch.
recovery.manual: If a later reviewed decision must reverse the marker, use a separately reviewed exact-version one-row UPDATE from is_anonymous=1 to 0. Never clear membership or historical links as recovery.

execution: Not executed. Root alone owns the authorized production preflight and write after code deployment.
